title: Taffou 2021 rear-left auditory roughness PPS
citation: Taffou, M., Suied, C., & Viaud-Delmon, I. (2021). Auditory roughness elicits defense reactions. Scientific Reports, 11, 956.
notes: The timing and block recipe requires two named, unbundled study audio files. Tbefore and Tafter are silent at touch, with a three-second looming sound on both trial types.

import_names: Taffou rough 70 Hz AM study audio
auditory_stimuli.relative_loudness: The authors used the Moore loudness model for matching and reported a 0.8 dB difference with the rough sound louder. Absolute SPL, exact level adjustment and rendered waveforms are unresolved.
auditory_stimuli.renderer: Max/MSP 6.1.8 with Spat, non-individual LISTEN HRTFs, direct sound, reflections through order three and late reverberation. Binaural near-field correction applied to direct sound.

reported_trajectory.toolkit_azimuth_conversion: Toolkit uses negative azimuth for the left. The physical side is preserved.
reported_trajectory.locator: pp. 2–4, Stimuli, Measure of PPS and Fig. 1

reported_trial_schedule.timing_at_T5: T5 coincides with nominal sound offset.
reported_trial_schedule.intermixing: Tactile conditions randomly intermingled with catches and divided equally in total across ten blocks.
reported_trial_schedule.unknown_allocations: Per-sound catch counts, per-block trial-type allocations, exact trial order and source seed are unspecified.
reported_trial_schedule.locator: pp. 3–4, Measure of PPS and Fig. 1

tactile_target.site: Palmar surface of left index finger

response_and_analysis.response: Press with the right index finger as quickly as possible when touch is detected. Ignore sound and withhold on audio-only trials.
response_and_analysis.primary_measure: Participant mean tactile RT by sound type and probe delay after excluding timing-error trials and RTs outside the stated bounds.
response_and_analysis.expectancy_adjustment: The supplement checks slopes by sound type, then uses pooled Tbefore and Tafter data to estimate each participant’s RT trend and remove the estimated change relative to Tbefore.
response_and_analysis.locator: pp. 2–4, Apparatus, Measure of PPS and Statistical analysis; original Supplementary Information, Fig. S2 and Tables S1–S2

implemented_controls: Two named audio inputs and seven sound-relative tactile timings.
Sound-bearing silent-at-touch probes at −650 and 3650 ms.
Ten blocks of 32 with 200 paired targets, 80 silent-at-touch targets and 40 sound-only catches after importing both assets.
implementation_gaps: Exact authorized rough and non-rough binaural audio files or a verified matching harmonic synthesis and Spat renderer. LISTEN subject/filter, exact source phases, loudness matching and near-field correction remain unresolved.
Calibrated actuator and scheduler for the calibrated 250 Hz fingertip probe, exact Veco drive amplitude and synchronized physical response capture.
Exact keypad mapping, online response policy and timing validation with the study’s presentation system.
Exact post-sound silence sampling, separate intertrial timing and realized randomization and catch allocations.

preview_contract.asset_import: Supply both authorized three-second stereo 44.1 kHz study tracks. Import with the two listed names, preserve mode, and unity gain. The Toolkit adds the surrounding silence.
preview_contract.tactile: Generated Toolkit tactile output is a timing marker. Matching the reported 250 Hz and 20 ms physical pulse requires a calibrated external route.
preview_contract.post_sound_silence_choice: Fixed midpoint for schedule inspection. The source reports variable silence but gives no sampling rule.
preview_contract.allocation: Seeded balanced blocks and equal per-sound catches are Toolkit choices. The source gives total block sizes and catch count.
preview_contract.distance: The five mapped distances are derived from the source’s linear path. Distances do not apply to the two silent probes or to catches.

provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-020-79767-0, pp. 3–4, Measure of PPS and Fig. 1.
https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-020-79767-0, pp. 4–8, Statistical analysis and Results. Original Supplementary Information, Fig. S2 and Tables S1–S2.
